info.title: PickChick foundation API
info.description: Local menu sync and unpaid POS orders, a gated synthetic TEST journey through two kitchen stations, and separate opt-in customer identity. Real identity requires approved policy URLs/version, protected keys, SMS budget and enabled Mobizon delivery. It never authenticates a local demo profile or adopts anonymous TEST history. Real checkout, payments and fiscal provider delivery remain disabled.

post.description: Authenticated immutable versioned edge fact. Admission uses actual device credentials; order/task observations never overwrite commercial money or award loyalty. post.description: Private, disabled-by-default unpaid POS lifecycle observation. Authenticated edge/branch/producer binding; immutable envelope hash, producer sequence identity and strict per-order commercial create v1 then cancel v2, or kitchen version+1. Kitchen has a separate immutable inbox and requires the unpaid commercial snapshot/owner hash. Sequence gaps across different orders are allowed. Never authorizes payment, fiscalization or kitchen admission. Not routed by the public gateway. Maximum accepted event 96 KiB; response 8 KiB.
